caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table placed centrally against a plain, off-white background. The table is illustrated in full color, primarily shades of brown, with realistic wood grain patterns throughout its surface, legs, and base. The tabletop is rectangular and has a slight overhang on the left side, while the right edge appears slightly angled or cut off. Below the tabletop, the table features two drawers, each with two round knob handles, making a total of four knobs visible. The supporting structure consists of a single, sturdy, tapering rectangular column attached to an ornate, wide, and curved base that rests flat on the ground. No other objects or decorations are present in the drawing. In the lower right corner, there is a small handwritten inscription.
title: Mahogany Sewing Table
